title: Seacrest Turtle Cove Rosemary Beach, Florida 30A Vacay
description_expanded: OverviewNewly Redesigned, Steps to the Lagoon Pool and Private Beach, 4 Bikes `Turtle Cove`The Space Stunning Seacrest Beach Retreat – Steps to Lagoon Pool & Beach! QUICK HIGHLIGHTS: Fully Redesigned with New Furnishings – Modern coastal luxury throughout Steps to the 12,000 Sq. Ft. Lagoon Pool – One of the largest pools on 30A! Ideal Location – Close to 2 Tram Stops – Quick & easy beach access Walking Distance to the Beach – A short stroll to the white sandy shores 4 Spacious Bedrooms / 4 Bathrooms – Comfortably accommodates up to 14 guests Open-Concept Living, Dining & Kitchen – Perfect for family gatherings 4 Adult Bikes Included – Explore Rosemary Beach, Alys Beach & nearby shops Green Space & Walking Path Behind Home – Enjoy peaceful surroundings Complimentary Wi-Fi & Smart TVs – Stay connected & entertained Professionally Managed – 24/7 guest support for a seamless vacation experience Welcome to Turtle Cove A stunning home just steps away from the best dining and shopping in Seacrest and Rosemary Beach! This home has incredible accommodations for 14 guests, including 4 beautiful bedrooms, 4 bathroom and large open floor plan kitchen, dining and living rooms. This home is just a short stroll to the Emerald Coast's white sandy beaches. If you happen to get tired of the beach, dive into the 12,000 sq. foot community pool for hours of sun and swimming. Hop on one of the 4 bicycles provided to enjoy the close proximity to some of the best shopping and dining on 30-A. With everything just moments away at neighboring Village of South Walton, Rosemary Beach, or Alys Beach a scenic stroll or bike ride often makes the journey just as magnificent as the destination. The location is ideal adjacent to 2 tram stops, 125 steps from the 12,500 sq. ft pool, and within walking distance to the beach. The lot backs up to the green space and walking path circling Seacrest. House Rules **No Pets!** **No Smoking!** **No Parties!** **The primary renter must be at least 25 years old** **No units will be rented to vacationing students or young adults under 25 unaccompanied by a responsible parent or guardian at a ratio of three (3) children/young adults to one (1) adult over the age of 25** **30A Vacay rental agreement is required to be signed prior to arrival** ** As of January 1, 2022, Golf Carts are prohibited in Seacrest Beach. Violators will be fined by the HOA.** SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (14): First Floor - Master Bedroom: King sized bed, private en suite bathroom with shower/tub combo Second Floor - Master Bedroom: King sized bed, private en suite bathroom with soaking tub and stand-up shower Second Floor - Guest Bedroom: Queen sized bed, shared bathroom Second Floor - Bunk Room: Queen sized bed, and two sets of twin over twin bunk beds with pull out trundle on each, shared bathroom AREA ATTRACTIONS: This easygoing beach neighborhood is the perfect place to escape for a beach vacation. Spend a day wandering through the shops and sights of Seacrest — you’ll spot everything from gorgeous dune lakes to gourmet restaurants. Then, unwind with a stroll along Seacrest’s sugar-white sand. A lively community gathers in Seacrest’s Peddler’s Pavilion. Sip coffee on an outdoor patio, stock up on homemade sweet treats, or rent a bicycle and go exploring. With wide-open green spaces and plenty of ecosploring opportunities, this beach neighborhood is a perfect fit for active vacationers.Show less
